post.summary: Creates a new user in a specified environment.
post.description: Creates a user resource in the PingOne environment. The user will belong to the specified population and can be enriched with additional attributes like name, department, contact info, and locale. A 201 status indicates successful creation. Use the response links for further user management tasks such as setting passwords or assigning roles.

parameters.name: envID
parameters.description: The environment ID in which the user is to be created.

400.description: Returned if the provided input data contains invalid values.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

get.summary: Retrieves a list of user resources from the specified PingOne environment.
get.description: Returns a paginated list of users. Supports SCIM-style filtering on query parameters like `username`, `email`, `name.given`, etc. The `limit` parameter can restrict the number of results. You must have the Identity Data Admin role to read group membership information.

parameters.name: envID
parameters.description: The PingOne environment ID.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of users to return (1–1000).

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: SCIM filter string (e.g., username eq "johnsmith").

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: next cursor link

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Expand nested entities like populations.

200.description: A list of user resources was returned successfully.

400.description: Returned if the request is malformed or includes invalid query parameters.

401.description: Returned if the request is unauthorized or the token is invalid.

get.summary: Retrieve a user resource by ID.
get.description: Retrieves a single user resource by its ID from a PingOne environment. Use the `expand=population` query parameter to include population details. You must have the Identity Data Admin role to read group membership.

parameters.name: envID
parameters.description: The PingOne environment ID.

parameters.name: userID
parameters.description: The unique ID of the user.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Optionally expand population details (e.g., expand=population).

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Optionally include group details (e.g., memberOfGroupNames, memberOfGroupIDs).

400.description: Returned if the request is malformed or includes invalid query parameters.

401.description: Returned if the request is unauthorized or the token is invalid.

404.description: Returned if the user with the given ID is not found.

delete.description: Deletes the specified user resource from the PingOne directory based on the provided environment and user ID. Returns HTTP 204 if successful.

parameters.name: envID
parameters.description: The PingOne environment ID.

parameters.name: userID
parameters.description: The unique ID of the user.

204.description: User deleted successfully. No content returned.

400.description: Returned if the request is malformed or includes invalid path parameters.

401.description: Returned if the request is unauthorized or the token is invalid.

404.description: Returned if the user with the given ID is not found.

put.description: Updates attribute properties for a specific user in a PingOne environment. The PUT operation replaces the existing values. Properties omitted from the request will be removed. A 403 error is returned if the user lacks permission to update specific attributes.

parameters.name: envID
parameters.description: The PingOne environment ID.

parameters.name: userID
parameters.description: The unique ID of the user.

400.description: Returned if the request is malformed or contains invalid values.

401.description: Returned if authentication credentials are missing or incorrect.

403.description: Returned if the user is not permitted to update specific attributes.

404.description: Returned if the user was not found.

patch.summary: Partially update user attributes by ID.
patch.description: Updates specific attribute properties for a user in a PingOne environment. Only the fields included in the PATCH body are updated. Fields not included remain unchanged. For multiValued attributes like `locales`, the entire array is replaced.

parameters.name: envID
parameters.description: The PingOne environment ID.

parameters.name: userID
parameters.description: The unique ID of the user.

400.description: Returned if the request is malformed or contains invalid values.

401.description: Returned if authentication credentials are missing or incorrect.

403.description: Returned if the user is not permitted to update specific attributes.

404.description: Returned if the user was not found.

post.summary: Assigns a role to a user within a specified scope in a given environment.
post.description: Creates a new role assignment for a user in the specified PingOne environment. The request body must include the role ID to be assigned and the scope in which the role applies. The scope type could be `ENVIRONMENT` or `POPULATION`, and the associated ID should match. This operation enables fine-grained control over user roles within PingOne environments.

parameters.name: envID
parameters.description: The ID of the environment where the user role assignment is to occur.

parameters.name: userID
parameters.description: The ID of the user to whom the role will be assigned.

400.description: Invalid request. The provided data may be malformed, exceed limits, or refer to non-existent role/scope/user.

401.description: Unauthorized. Missing or invalid authentication token.

403.description: Forbidden. The authenticated user does not have permission to assign the specified role.

404.description: Resource not found. Either the user, environment, or role does not exist.

409.description: Conflict. The role is already assigned to the user in the given scope.

get.summary: Retrieves all role assignments for a specified user.
get.description: Returns a list of all roles assigned to a user within the specified PingOne environment. Each role assignment includes the role ID, the scope in which it applies, and links to the relevant resources.

parameters.name: envID
parameters.description: The PingOne environment ID.

parameters.name: userID
parameters.description: The ID of the user whose role assignments are being retrieved.

200.description: List of roles assigned to the user retrieved successfully.

401.description: Unauthorized. Missing or invalid authentication token.

get.summary: Retrieves a specific role assignment for a user.
get.description: Returns the role assignment resource identified by `roleAssignmentID` for the user specified by `userID` in the given environment. The response contains details about the role, its scope, and associated links.

parameters.name: envID
parameters.description: The PingOne environment ID.

parameters.name: userID
parameters.description: The ID of the user who holds the role assignment.

parameters.name: roleAssignmentID
parameters.description: The ID of the role assignment to retrieve.

200.description: The role assignment was retrieved successfully.

401.description: Unauthorized. The request is missing a valid access token.

404.description: Not Found. The specified role assignment does not exist or is not associated with the given user/environment.

delete.summary: Deletes a specific role assignment from a user.
delete.description: Deletes the role assignment identified by `roleAssignmentID` for the user identified by `userID` in the specified PingOne environment. This operation removes the role assignment only for the specified user.

parameters.name: envID
parameters.description: The PingOne environment ID.

parameters.name: userID
parameters.description: The ID of the user whose role assignment is being deleted.

parameters.name: roleAssignmentID
parameters.description: The ID of the role assignment to delete.

204.description: Role assignment successfully deleted. No content is returned.

401.description: Unauthorized. The request is missing a valid access token.

404.description: Not Found. The specified role assignment does not exist or does not belong to the given user/environment.

get.summary: Retrieves all roles available in the specified environment.
get.description: Returns a list of all roles defined within the specified PingOne environment. Each role includes its ID, name, description, applicable scopes, permissions, and assignment eligibility.

parameters.name: envID
parameters.description: The PingOne environment ID.

200.description: A list of roles was returned successfully.
